overall: The AG found the commission violated the Open Meeting Law by discussing a conservation agent candidate at its October 19 meeting without that topic on the notice; no further remedy was ordered because the topic was re-noticed and discussed November 7.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the commission discussed and voted to hire a conservation agent at its Oct. 19 meeting though that topic was not on the posted notice.
allegations.key_passage: Therefore, we find that the Commission violated the Open Meeting Law by discussing Ms. Grenier's candidacy during the October 19 meeting where that topic was not included on the meeting notice.

remedy: Immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law; a caution that future findings of a similar violation may be considered an intent to violate the law.
remedy_passage: We order the Commission’s immediate and future compliance with the Open Meeting Law and caution that future findings of a similar violation may be considered an intent to violate the law.
note: Read by a language model from the letter; every key passage is checked verbatim against it and dropped if not. A holding is the Attorney General’s reading of the law in this case only.
